d: Pete is in Utopia for a joint venture: a treehouse B&B built for romance. It will have stained glass, a bedroom - and the biggest bathroom Pete has ever built.
Stranded, freezing and desperate for food, Adam and Evan make a dangerous journey to basecamp. Meanwhile, Oliver tries to survive solo as temperatures plummet.
Atz builds a bridge and encounters a predator in the backcountry. Otto's hay season nearly comes to a halt when a broken tractor forces him to get creative.
Full of exclusive interviews and insider facts, these are Browntown's most inventive transportation builds. Plus, Bear, Bird and Rain build an extreme bush raft.
A mother is worried about her daughter's visions of a bloodied girl and a car crash. Does her child need psychiatric help, or do demonic spirits lurk in their home.
Love is in the air at Australia Zoo! Terri helps determine if Caballe the Rhino is pregnant, while Robert matchmakes the zoo's Aldabra giant tortoises.
Richard E Grant explores the evolutionary roots of Lust - the intense, out-of-control craving ... for sex. Animals feel lust too - otherwise species would die out.
Pete is in Utopia for a joint venture: a treehouse B&B built for romance. It will have stained glass, a bedroom - and the biggest bathroom Pete has ever built.
EAMT AJ Meadows has a fight on her hands trying to save seven dogs locked in a hot car, with no food or water. Can AJ save them before it's too late.
When a kitten is trapped and in desperate need of help, emergency animal medical technician Traci Pepper faces her fears and risks her own life to save him.

George and Beth are prisoners in their own home due to their vicious kitty Reese. Reese is a cat version of Jack the Ripper and Beth is one of his choice targets.
Terri, Bindi and Robert prepare Croc One, Steve Irwin's research ship, for a special mission to release an endangered sea turtle back into the wild.
Wild weather hits Texas, Eddins is the first responder to a downed power line with active wires. Meanwhile, Richards attempts to serve an arrest warrant.
Dr. Jeff helps 40 miniature Australian shepherds rescued from a puppy mill. And, vet technician Christine needs Dr. Jeff's help when her chihuahua struggles to walk.
Dr. Jeff helps a beloved German shepherd walk again. Meanwhile, Dr. Don has to act fast when a cat eats poison and a scared dog runs loose outside the clinic.
Kanani and his fiancée M2 are busy preparing for their upcoming wedding. Plus, Jammall finds an abandoned dog and he needs Mariah's help to rescue it.
Villalobos throws a Halloween party to raise money for the rescue. An old friend returns and Lizzy struggles to rescue a stray dog in the middle of the night.
The behaviour of Sebastian, a violent cat, puts a new-born baby in jeopardy. Plus, a door opening wild cat, Zeus, is threatening to leave his owner.
A tantrum-prone cat lives in fear of the other two cats living in the same home. Plus, Jackson tutors a bouncer on how to handle his sweet Tasmanian devil of a cat.
Pete is in Virginia for a build at the Bella Rose Plantation. Inspired by Thomas Jefferson, he designs a luxurious treehouse with colonial columns.
The Barn Sanctuary pigs are ready to move into their spacious new palace. Plus, the staff put on a memorial after Andy the cow passes away.
New science and demonstrations reveal how cats can detect an earthquake seconds before it happens. And, how do sea otters keep warm in icy waters.
New science and amazing demonstrations reveal why elephants have trunks. Plus, why do some animals live so long, and why do cats purr.
Forrest teams up with an expert in Newfoundland seeking the white wolf, which was declared extinct in 1930. They meet a hunter convinced he shot one.
When an ostrich lays its first egg, the Brown siblings rush to work out how to incubate it. And, Bear gets a special visit from a girl on North Star Ranch.
Donut Mania is Brett's newest business venture and they're having a grand opening. Wayde and the team want to congratulate him with a surprise fish tank.
Atz Lee and Jane rush to the aid of a neighbour who has lost access to fresh water on her homestead. Charlotte takes measures to protect her herd from predators.

t: The Lost Kingdom Of The Yeti
d: In the high-altitude wilderness of Bhutan, new evidence hints that the mysterious yeti may exist. Mark Evans travels into the Himalayas to discover the truth.
Jay and Elke call in a veteran demonologist after hearing ghostly threats and finding bloody handprints on their baby's crib. Can Father Bob expel the spirits.
Forrest teams up with an expert in Newfoundland seeking the white wolf, which was declared extinct in 1930. They meet a hunter convinced he shot one.
The staff head to Manhattan to rescue a wallaby living in an apartment. A fruit bat learns to spread her wings, and some alligators move into their summer home.

Alan and Shannon wanted a cat to cuddle, but instead they got Barnabas - a hissing, flesh ripping cat. The only thing that calms him down is opera music.
Robert follows in Steve's steps wrangling Utah, a highly venomous King Cobra. A vet from the zoo's hospital, Dr. Amber, visits Tandora to treat wild Koalas.
A badly injured tortoise needs an innovative procedure and an eagle's death is investigated. As night falls, a car crash turns into a manhunt.
Dr. Jeff visits a free clinic and returns with a dog who was hit by a car. Plus, he helps a dog with a mysterious lump and Dr. Baier wants to keep a rescue puppy.
Dr. Jeff treats a cherished Bloodhound puppy that won't eat. Plus, Dr. Petra comes to the rescue of a cat after it swallowed a handful of hair ties.
The family of Mutt, a Villalobos employee who recently passed away, meets the dog he chose for them. Plus, Tia and M2 go on a wild goose chase near a school.
After a challenging rescue, Tiana is shocked by the condition of a stray dog. Meanwhile, Tia and the family tackle their messy pigeon problem.
Jackson works with a cat, Skylar, who's literally afraid of her own tail. Plus, Jackson meets up with a pair of guardians whose cat is constantly knocking things over.
Jackson meets up with a soft-spoken musician who feels abused by her adopted cat and is ashamed that she can't figure out how to prevent her cat's behaviour.
Pete's build in Washington will fuse action and relaxing. With a bouncy-bridge entryway and a zip-line through the forest, it's a thrill-seekers' haven.
A dog loves all things ice cream and another dog keeps getting his head stuck in things. Plus, a parrot has a habit of rapping and swearing.
A game of underwater copycat shows how smart dolphins really are. How do hyenas eat almost anything? And, how do geckos defy gravity.
Space Bugs And Squirrel Mind Maps. Are alligators music lovers? How a squirrel can hide up to 10,000 nuts in one season and still find most of them? And, can a bug survive in space.
On a rainy day, Shaun is called out to Covington and braves wet conditions to bring down a friendly stray that obviously misses his home.
Shaun travels to La Conner to rescue Play-Play, whose distraught owner watches nearly 70 feet below. Meanwhile, Tom is called out on a late night mission.
The Browns flee the mountain during a dangerous lightning storm in the heat of fire season. To ensure their safety, they devise ingenious new fire safety measures.
Triple Tank Throwdown! Businessman Brad Jennings wants to complete his new office with three tanks. The guys work on three complementary interiors which include a working fireplace.
Otto and Eivin fight to douse a raging coal fire on Kilcher beach that threatens the homestead. Meanwhile, Atz Sr attempts an unconventional bear hunt.
A rancher along the river is threatened by a predatory bear that is stalking the homestead and is forced to aggressively protect himself and his cattle.
The Barn Sanctuary pigs are ready to move into their spacious new palace. Plus, the staff put on a memorial after Andy the cow passes away.
Lady in White / Thump in the Night. A couple are bemused when their beloved rabbits behave nervously. But then a strange figure appears and their pets start dying - why.
In the Mexican desert Bradley Trevor Greive and Billy Almon track down and test the almost supernatural abilities of the giant horned lizard.
The team scours the Sonoran Desert for North America's carnivorous grasshopper mouse. Its bite and vertical leap turn it into a vicious scorpion killer at night.
Great Snakes! After more than 100 venomous snakes are taken from a private home, it's up to the zoo to care for them. Plus, two pronghorn fawns make their debut.

Marco and Aimee recently got married, but Marco's cat, Monty, is tearing them apart with his appetite for destruction - and will eat everything in sight.
Dan races to North Carolina to rescue a group of pigs from horrific living conditions. Plus, the organisation's new sign is put on display.
Oz Tank. Dr. Oz wants to add some fresh water fish to his home. The tank will have an Oz themed interior that will have fish swimming down the yellow brick road.
Emergency animal medical technicians McHugh and Meadows rush to the aid of two badly injured dogs. And an exotic turtle is a reluctant patient.
When the Arizona Humane Society helps a boxer fight for life, medical technician Traci Pepper takes her home and nurses her back to health.
Robert travels to the Great Barrier Reef to help conduct research on manta rays. Plus, the zoo's staff team up to save a baby wallaby struggling to survive.
Two strays lead Lizzy and Villalobos staff on a wild goose chase. A grandmother comes in looking for another canine companion, but her dog Daisy has other plans.
Jackson enters Ellen's world, one that's crawling with neighbourhood feral cats, who she's been feeding and trying to contain virtually by herself for 20 years.
Jackson makes his way to Brooklyn, where a couple are seeing their relationship suffer over the ongoing blood feud between their two cats.
Wardens Gould and Scott respond to a call about deer carcasses that have been illegally dumped on private property. And, stray bullets hit a horse owner's home.
Dr. Jeff and the team head to a remote town offering low-cost care to pets. Plus, Dr. Petra performs life-saving surgery on a Basset Hound that was hit by a car.
Pete builds a citadel fortress for a couple who loves all things medieval. A high tower will hold a round table and thrones, as well as a glass floor loft.
Attack survivor Jenny Oliver and researcher Kina Scollay are on a quest to find out if the mysterious Sevengill sharks are targeting divers- and are they hunting in packs.
The Kilchers take Thanksgiving off the homestead and onto Atz Sr's floating homestead, the Yuletide. Each person brings something special to share.
Loaded with exclusive interviews and insider facts, these are examples of Browntown's most electrifying bushcraft power. Plus, Bear's treehouse is powered up.
Andrew and his mum were both being tormented by the same ghost but kept it a secret - so how did they find out about their home's horrible history.
